items.stem: How do you enable debug mode?

options.text: Open the agent in Builder and toggle debug mode in the preview pane, then run it.
Submit a support request to have debugging enabled.
Re-publish the agent with a debug flag in its name.

items.stem: What does the debug trace expose?

options.text: Inputs, including referenced memory and variables, and outputs, including raw tool and LLM responses.
Only a pass or fail status per step.

items.stem: A step returns an HTTP validation error and a partial write. Which category?
The agent reports a document not found, but it is indexed. Which category?
What is the recommended debugging workflow once debug mode is on?

options.text: Filter to only show errors, open the failing step, compare inputs against outputs, then iterate with Try Again or Reset Preview.
Read every step in order from the beginning each time.
